claims: The Artemis II rocket is officially the Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1.
The Artemis II rocket is 322 feet tall.
The Artemis II rocket is a super-heavy lift vehicle.
The Artemis II rocket is designed to launch four astronauts in the Orion capsule around the Moon in early 2025.
The Artemis II rocket is the first crewed flight of the SLS.
The Artemis II rocket utilizes over 8.8 million pounds of thrust.
The Artemis II rocket sends astronauts on a 10-day test mission to prove life support systems
